summary: The first public release of HyperMusic for Android brings music and podcast streaming, offline downloads and local music playback. Available for Android 8.0 and later. Open source under GPL-3.0-or-later.

features: Discovery and search. Browse new releases, moods and mixes, or find songs, albums, artists and podcasts. Includes search suggestions, voice search on supported devices, and content language and region settings.
Background playback. Listen to music and podcasts with notification and lock-screen controls. Switch to video for supported content.
Local music. Browse music in your library’s From Device section. Device files support playback and queueing; adding them to Liked Songs or saved playlists is not supported.
Offline downloads. Download supported tracks and podcast episodes, including video for supported podcasts. Pause, resume or cancel downloads, with a Wi-Fi-only option.
Your library. Create playlists, like tracks, save albums and podcasts, follow artists, and keep episodes for later. Your library is stored locally, with no HyperMusic account required.
Queue and history. Add, remove and reorder tracks, shuffle or repeat, and enable autoplay. Optionally keep your queue between sessions and revisit recently played tracks.
Lyrics and sharing. View synced or plain lyrics where available, translate lyrics on demand, share selected lines as text or a lyric card, and share track links.
Quality settings. Choose Data Saver, Standard or High separately for streaming and downloads. Available quality depends on the source.
Sound controls. Adjust equalizer bands or use presets, bass boost, virtualizer, loudness boost and skip silence. Some audio effects depend on device support.
Sleep timer. Stop playback after 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes, or when the current track ends.
Themes and player colors. Choose Light, Dark or System Default, with optional artwork-driven player colors.
Widgets and shortcuts. Choose from four home-screen widget layouts. Open Search, Playlists, Liked Songs or History through supported launcher shortcuts.
Storage and updates. Review storage usage, clear caches, history or downloads, and check for app updates from Settings.
No app-inserted ads. HyperMusic does not insert ads into playback or display ad banners. Sponsorships included in the original content may still play.
